Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.

250-779-1479-5414-7885.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-7885.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5414-7885.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

1357-4697-5938.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
1357-4697-5938.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Holding priority, cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost or by sacrificing a red nontoken creature, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
1357-4697-5938.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.
